result.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Submodular Trajectory Rewards
result.summary: We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning with decoupled dynamics and a monotone submodular reward function over joint trajectories. Due to the non-additive reward, an optimal policy may depend on the history of all agents. This dependence makes exact optimization exponential in the horizon and the number of agents. To overcome this challenge while retaining theoretical guarantees, we introduce pre-window curvature $c_m$, which quantifies how states visited more than $m$ steps earlier reduce current marginal gains. Using this curvature to control the error from restricting the policy of each agent to depend only on its last $m+1$ states, we propose a greedy algorithm that exploits the decoupled dynamics to optimize local policies sequentially. For fixed $m$, the algorithm achieves a $\frac{1-c_m}{2-c_m}$ approximation guarantee up to estimation error, and its computation time is polynomial in the number of agents and the horizon. We recover the known $1/2$-factor approximation for time-additive rewards and obtain an approximation factor no smaller than the known total-curvature bound for a single agent. We formulate multi-agent traffic monitoring as an example of this framework and evaluate our algorithm on it.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究解耦动力学下、以联合轨迹上的单调次模奖励为目标的合作多智能体强化学习，提出 pre-window curvature c_m 来量化「每个智能体只依赖最近 m+1 个状态」造成的误差，并给出顺序优化局部策略的多项式时间贪心算法，获得 (1-c_m)/(2-c_m) 的近似保证，并在多智能体交通监控示例上评估。
